### RECITALS: AUTHORIZATION OF CREDIT FACILITY & CAPITAL RESTRUCTURING

**WHEREAS**, the Board of Directors (the "Board") of [Company Name], a [Delaware] corporation (the "Company"), has reviewed and evaluated the commercial terms of a proposed Senior Secured Revolving Credit and Term Loan Facility (the "Credit Facility") with [Lender / Financial Institution Name] (the "Lender") in an aggregate principal amount of up to **$[XX,000,000]**;

**WHEREAS**, the Board has reviewed the Credit Agreement, Security and Pledge Agreement, Promissory Notes, and associated ancillary financing agreements (collectively, the "Financing Documents"); and

**WHEREAS**, the Board has determined in its business judgment that entering into the Credit Facility is in the best interests of the Company and its stockholders to fund ongoing working capital requirements, strategic capital expenditures, and corporate expansion;

---

### RESOLUTIONS:

**NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED**, that the form, terms, and provisions of the Credit Agreement and Financing Documents be, and they hereby are, approved, ratified, and confirmed in all respects;

**RESOLVED FURTHER**, that the Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, President, and Secretary of the Company (each, an "Authorized Officer") be, and each of them individually hereby is, authorized and empowered in the name and on behalf of the Company to execute and deliver the Financing Documents in substantially the form presented to the Board, with such additions, deletions, or changes as the Authorized Officer executing the same shall approve (such execution to be conclusive evidence of such approval);

**RESOLVED FURTHER**, that the grant of a first-priority security interest in and lien upon substantially all of the personal and real property assets of the Company to secure the obligations under the Financing Documents be, and hereby is, approved and ratified;

**RESOLVED FURTHER**, that the Authorized Officers are authorized to file all financing statements (UCC-1), pledge certificates, and mortgages necessary or desirable to perfect the security interests granted to the Lender;

**RESOLVED FURTHER**, that any and all actions heretofore taken by any director, officer, or agent of the Company in connection with the transactions contemplated by the foregoing resolutions are hereby adopted, ratified, and confirmed as the acts and deeds of the Company.

---

### IN WITNESS WHEREOF:

The undersigned, being all the members of the Board of Directors of the Company, have executed this Unanimous Written Consent as of the date first written above.
